records.finding: The code attributes OFA to Hao et al. (2023) and uses a released frozen Prithvi task teacher with existing pseudo-labeling, filtering/diversity and QAT components. Implemented adaptations include six-band student input, per-pixel OFA heads discarded at inference, the task recipe and deployment graph rewrites. The contribution supported by existing results is a bounded transfer and compression pipeline; it is not a new universally superior KD algorithm.
records.smallest_remedy: Attribute reused components and identify implemented adaptations with measured domain/device limits. The later Discussion and reviewer-response pass remains pending.

records.affected_results: Claims about null method extensions.
records.claim: Feature matching and PCGrad are proved futile by a teacher-information ceiling.
records.finding: The supplement reports MSE feature-matching and PCGrad null results. A bounded artifact search found the published CKA values and six gradient-diagnostic CSVs (N=100/300/500, seeds 42/64), but did not recover matched feature/PCGrad accuracy trial logs and checkpoint identities. Legacy documents also report nulls and proposed explanations without complete matched execution evidence. Preserve these as paper-reported nulls with their confidence limit. The raw N=2,500 OFA/KD inconsistency is separately verified. CKA and gradient directions do not prove optimization causality or universal futility.
records.smallest_remedy: Use traceable raw nulls where available; label the other trials paper-reported with unrecovered execution identity. Do not launch new XAI, gradient or CKA work to fill the gap.

records.affected_results: Novelty, information argument and claimed limitations of extensions.
records.claim: Deterministic teacher signals prove an accuracy ceiling or identical student optima, and a binary soft mask contains one bit per image.
records.finding: Conditioning on fixed teacher parameters and inputs makes a deterministic auxiliary signal's conditional information zero. This does not bound ground-truth accuracy or the optimization and regularization effects of that signal. A binary soft distribution has one continuous probability degree of freedom per pixel; masks and features have spatial structure. Supplement S9 already explicitly rejects a performance ceiling and notes that the focal optimum need not be its CE convex mixture. Its unrestricted fixed-temperature KD+CE formula is not an exact optimum statement for the executed focal/T² mixture with hard logits at T=1. Multiclass differences remain untested.
records.smallest_remedy: Retain the conditional information statement with its conditions. Remove accuracy-ceiling, futility and universal-optimum implications in the later writing pass.

records.affected_results: Future contribution claims and queue scope.

New modalities need alignment and missing-modality controls. Prompt2 excludes these training extensions, new teachers, multiclass/XAI work and new hardware. None were launched in this audit.
records.smallest_remedy: Keep these studies excluded and unclaimed; finish the current evidence audit without adding training.
